mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_bookmark (user_id, type_id, type) VALUES (#{userId}, #{typeId}, #{type});
mapper.select: SELECT tb.* FROM t_bookmark tb JOIN t_event te on tb.type_id = te.id WHERE tb.user_id = #{userId} AND tb.type = 'EVENT' AND te.state = 'ACTIVE' AND te.date_started < NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ AND te.date_end > NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ ORDER BY tb.date_created LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{page} * #{size};

SELECT tb.* FROM t_bookmark tb JOIN t_article ta on tb.type_id = ta.id WHERE tb.user_id = #{userId} AND tb.type = 'ARTICLE' AND ta.available_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY tb.date_created LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{page} * #{size};

SELECT tb.* FROM t_bookmark tb JOIN t_hospital th on tb.type_id = th.id WHERE tb.user_id = #{userId} AND tb.type = 'HOSPITAL' AND th.state = 'ACTIVE' AND th.deleted_yn = 'N' ORDER BY th.exposed_rank, tb.date_created LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{page} * #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_bookmark tb INNER JOIN t_article ta ON tb.type_id = ta.id WHERE tb.user_id = #{userId} AND tb.type = 'ARTICLE' AND ta.available_yn = 'Y';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_bookmark tb INNER JOIN t_hospital th ON tb.type_id = th.id WHERE tb.user_id = #{userId} AND tb.type = 'HOSPITAL' AND th.state = 'ACTIVE';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_bookmark tb INNER JOIN t_event te ON tb.type_id = te.id WHERE tb.user_id = #{userId} AND tb.type = 'EVENT' AND te.state = 'ACTIVE' AND te.date_started < NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ AND te.date_end > NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ;
